class.name: RadialDamage3D
class.brief_description: Area damage with distance falloff and cover checks, for example an explosion.
class.description: When [method apply_damage] is called, every physics body within [member radius] whose node (or one of its ancestors) has the method [member damage_method] receives damage. Bodies within [member inner_radius] take the full [member damage]; beyond it the damage falls off linearly to zero at [member radius]. The distance is measured to the nearest point of the target's collision shapes. With [member use_cover], rays are cast from this node to the center and eight inset corners of each target against [member obstacle_mask]. A target hidden from all of them takes no damage; a partly covered target takes the visible share (for example 4 of 9 rays visible = 44% of the damage). The damage method is called with as many arguments as it accepts: [code]amount[/code], then [code]hit_position[/code] and [code]hit_direction[/code]. A character with several colliders or hitboxes is damaged once. [RigidBody3D] targets are pushed away by [member impulse]. Nothing is damaged in the editor. As a child of a [ParticleEffect3D], it fires automatically at its start time (see [method ParticleEffect3D.set_emitter_delay]).

method.name: apply_damage
method.description: Deals damage to everything in range now.

method.name: get_damage_at_distance
method.description: Returns the damage before cover at the given distance from this node.

members.member: Physics layers of the bodies that can be damaged or pushed.

Physics layers that provide cover and block the damage.

signal.name: damaged
signal.description: Emitted for each damaged node with the dealt amount and the visible share ([code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]).
